cornea.label: cornea
cornea.tip: The clear front window. It bends light even more than the lens does.

iris.label: iris
iris.tip: The colored ring. Its muscles make the pupil bigger or smaller.

pupil.label: pupil
pupil.tip: The hole in the iris that lets light in.

lens.label: lens
lens.tip: A clear, bendy disc that fine-tunes the focus for near or far things.

focusMuscle.label: ciliary muscle
focusMuscle.tip: The focus muscle: a ring that changes the lens's shape to focus near or far.

sclera.label: sclera
sclera.tip: The white of the eye: a tough outer wall that keeps the eye in shape.

choroid.label: choroid
choroid.tip: A dark layer full of blood vessels that feeds the retina.

vitreous.label: vitreous humor
vitreous.tip: Clear jelly that fills most of the eye and keeps it round. Light passes straight through it.

retina.label: retina
retina.tip: The light-sensing layer at the back, like the sensor in a camera.

blindSpot.label: optic disc
blindSpot.tip: Where the optic nerve leaves the eye. It has no light sensors, so it makes a blind spot.

fovea.label: fovea
fovea.tip: The sharpest spot: a tiny pit packed with light sensors that sees the finest detail.

opticNerve.label: optic nerve
opticNerve.tip: The cable that carries the picture to the brain.

wiring.label: nerve fiber layer
wiring.tip: The nerve wiring: fibers that collect the signals from the light sensors.

tapetum.label: tapetum lucidum
tapetum.tip: The night reflector: a shiny layer that bounces light back through the retina for a second chance. It makes eyes glow in the dark.

settings.label: Eye size
settings.tip: Bigger eyes catch more light and see finer detail, but cost more to grow and carry.

settings.label: Retina facing
settings.tip: Which way the light sensors point.

options.label: Away from light
options.tip: The wiring sits in front of the sensors and leaves through a hole: a blind spot.

options.label: Toward light
options.tip: The wiring sits behind the sensors, so there is no blind spot.

settings.label: Focus
settings.tip: The distance the eye is focused on. Things nearer or farther look blurry.

settings.label: Pupil shape
settings.tip: The shape of the opening that lets light in.

options.label: Slit
options.tip: Closes very tightly in bright light. Common in hunters that are active day and night.

options.label: Horizontal
options.tip: Sees a wide strip of the ground or sea.

settings.label: Pupil size
settings.tip: A bigger opening lets in more light, but only things at the focus distance stay sharp.

settings.label: Tapetum lucidum (night reflector)
settings.tip: A shiny layer that bounces light back through the retina. Brighter at night, but more glare.

options.label: On
options.tip: Light gets a second pass, and the eyes glow in the dark.

settings.label: Color vision
settings.tip: How many kinds of color sensors the eye has. More kinds tell more colors apart.

options.label: 1 color
options.tip: One kind of color sensor: shades of one color only.

options.label: 2 colors
options.tip: Two kinds: like most dogs and cats.

options.label: 4 colors
options.tip: Four kinds: like many birds, including ultraviolet.

options.label: 5 colors
options.tip: Five kinds: more than any screen can show.

settings.label: Red and green
settings.tip: Some people's red and green sensors are too alike, so reds and greens get confused.

options.label: Red-green colorblind
options.tip: Reds and greens look more alike.

settings.label: How strong
settings.tip: From slightly mixed-up reds and greens to not telling them apart at all.

eyes.label: Human
eyes.hint: One lens focuses light onto the back of the eye, like a camera.

eyes.label: Octopus
eyes.hint: A camera eye like ours, but wired the other way round, so it has no blind spot.

eyes.label: Jumping spider
eyes.hint: A long tube with a lens at each end, like a tiny telescope.

eyes.label: Wasp
eyes.hint: A dome of thousands of tiny eyes, each seeing one dot of the picture.

eyes.label: Scallop
eyes.hint: A curved mirror at the back bounces light forward onto the seeing layer.

eyes.label: Cat
eyes.hint: A camera eye with a slit pupil and a shiny layer that helps at night.

eyes.label: Eagle
eyes.hint: A large camera eye with two extra-sharp spots for spotting prey far away.

eyes.label: Whale
eyes.hint: A camera eye built for dim, deep water, with a round lens.
